newsitem.title: UK: Sun unit agrees to buy Ashbourne.
newsitem.headline: Sun unit agrees to buy Ashbourne.

text.p: U.S.-backed Exceler Health Care Group Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed the takeover, at 177p per share, of British nursing homes company Ashbourne Plc.

Exceler, owned by Sun Health Care Group Inc, already owns 29.2 percent of Ashbourne and the offer values the entire issued capital of the British company at about 95 million stg, the firms said in a statement.

Shares in Ashbourne leaped last week, after the company said it had been approached with a bid proposal. The shares had been trading at a level of around 140 pence but on November 25 jumped to nearer 165 pence.
In early trade today the company's shares rose 14 pence to 175 pence, just under the offer level.
Under the terms of the deal, Ashbourne shareholders will not lose their rights to a proposed 2.8 pence dividend in respect of the year ended September 30.

Commenting on the offer, Chet Bradeen, managing director of Exceler, said, "the acquisition of Ashbourne will establish the enlarged group as one of the UK's most significant players in the nursing home market."
The enlarged group will trade under the Ashbourne name.
